concepts.title: Simple flat cartoon
concepts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Create ONE wide 16:9 landscape concept image for a 2D side-view suburban superhero game. This is a MUCH SIMPLER, LOW-DETAIL art exploration: flat solid colors, bold black cartoon outlines, big uncluttered shapes, almost no interior linework, absolutely NO textures, halftone, hatching, grain, gradients, detailed reflections, individual leaves, roof shingles, brick patterns, tiny decorations or realistic materials. Aim for clean simple cartoon game assets whose simplicity matches a stick figure. Large areas of empty sky and open play space. At most TWO very simple houses and TWO rounded trees in the background. Every prop constructed from a handful of shapes. Minimal or no shading. Sunny, cheerful, playful suburb.
Reference image role: CHARACTER IDENTITY ONLY. Preserve the supplied MC's oversized plain white round head, two tiny black oval eyes, simple curved happy smile, thin black stick-line torso and limbs with round ends, small bright red cape. One MC only. No suit, clothes, shoes, gloves, chest emblem, hair or muscular anatomy. Do not reproduce the reference's lime background. Character facing right with face still readable.
Composition: fixed SIDE ELEVATION, horizontal sidewalk across lower third, asphalt strip one curb below it, straight-on side profiles of houses and car. NOT isometric, NOT 3D, NOT behind-the-runner, no vanishing-point road. One simple car approaching from right, nose pointing left, no perspective enlargement, solid body, one window shape and two black disc wheels. MC left of center, around 20 percent of frame height. Keep all contact edges readable. No text, UI, lettering, logos, watermarks, collage or panels. Finished raster illustration with crisp outlined flat-color shapes.
Variation A: The cleanest flat-color Saturday morning cartoon. Bright sky blue, grass green, warm cream, muted coral, black and red. Two simple cream houses each with triangular roof, one door, two plain windows. One round-canopy tree. No fence slats or garden clutter. MC in a cheerful jump, red cape trailing. Ahead is one simple green bush made from three rounded lobes, touched by a small orange flame with a pale center from his outstretched line arm. One small red car side-on at right. Very simple gray lidded trash can at far left. Large open spaces; geometric economy; consistent thick outlines on MC and foreground, lighter outlines on background.
